scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:components && pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:excalidraw-app
scripts.build:excalidraw-app: pnpm --dir ../../apps/excalidraw-mcp run build && mkdir -p dist && cp ../../apps/excalidraw-mcp/dist/mcp-app.html dist/mcp-app.html
scripts.components:load: mkdir -p .wassette-components && wassette component load file://$PWD/core/dist/excalidraw-core.wasm --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components && wassette component load file://$PWD/components/dist/c4-pipeline.wasm --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components && wassette component load file://$PWD/components/dist/c4-compiler.wasm --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components && wassette component load file://$PWD/components/dist/excalidraw-policy.wasm --component-dir $PWD/.wassette-components
scripts.test: sh contracts/c4-pipeline/validate.sh && pnpm --dir components test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:components && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/mermaid-to-excalidraw run build && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/mermaid-to-excalidraw exec vitest --run tests/cssUtils.test.ts tests/examples.test.ts tests/sequence.test.ts tests/state.test.ts tests/utils.test.ts && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/c4-gondolin run build && pnpm --dir ../../adapters/c4-gondolin test
